Description

CSTP-2.10 is a joint development of our company and the Far Eastern Federal University. The 8U format is intermediate in size, weight and energy capabilities between the 3U and 12U platforms. We talked about its uniqueness and purpose in more detail in this post.

The 8-unit CSTP-2.10 device will measure the concentration of cosmic particles in near-Earth space in the interests of Roshydromet. Its uniqueness lies in the presence of a propulsion system and a navigation system that is resistant to complex interference conditions. There is also an experimental model of a star sensor of STC's own design on board.
